svg.text: Each change gives a tile the next
version of one counter for the screen.
The outlined tiles are newer than
what A has, so they are A's dirty tiles.
A key that A pressed drew this one,
so it goes first, in a frame of its own.
one for each viewer, on a goroutine of its own
each encoding made once, for every viewer
the same stages, against what B was sent, at B's pace
The framebuffer is the session's. What each viewer was sent, its writer and its pace are the viewer's own.
